memoryHook: Befindlich: whatever happens to be there.

options: before a noun, in formal writing
quiz.answer: before a noun, in formal writing

quiz.prompt: It is related to the verb…

goodToKnow: Befindlich is a stiff adjective from sich befinden, meaning located or present, and it appears in formal texts: Die im Gebäude befindlichen Personen müssen es verlassen. It nearly always sits before a noun, packed with a location phrase, which is typical of Amtsdeutsch. In speech, say: Das Archiv, das im Keller ist. Das Befinden is a different word, meaning state of health.
